```{r}
get_favorability_score <- function(empirical_dist) {
    return (empirical_dist[1] - empirical_dist[3])/sum(empirical_dist)
}
```

```{r}
run_favorability_test <- function(empirical_dist, n_boot_obs=100){
    obs_fave = get_favorability_score(empirical_dist)

    n_obs <- sum(empirical_dist)
    null_distribution <- c(
        (empirical_dist[1] + empirical_dist[3])/2, # equalized rate of wins
        empirical_dist[2], # rate of ties
        (empirical_dist[1] + empirical_dist[3])/2  # equalized rate of losses
    )/n_obs

    all_null_faves = c()
    for (b in 1:n_boot_obs) {
        null_dist = simulate_null_data(n_obs, null_distribution)
        null_fave = get_favorability_score(null_dist)
        all_null_faves = c(all_null_faves, null_fave)
    }
    p_val = mean(abs(all_null_faves) > abs(obs_fave))
    return p_val
}
```
